entities.summary: Jonathan Augustus Martin is an American former professional football player who was an offensive tackle in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Stanford Cardinal. Martin was selected by the Miami Dolphins in the second round of the 2012 NFL draft. He also played for the San Francisco 49ers.
